programme.desc: New bridegroom called to D.C. to explain what happened to a navy destroyer escort gone since WWII.

programme.title: Who's Minding The Store?
programme.desc: An incompetent young man is given a job in a department store by his girlfriend's mother, who hopes to put an end to their romance.

programme.title: The Errand Boy
programme.desc: Morty S. Tashman, under the guise of studio mail clerk, is to roam the lot and then report back to the boss with any questionable or dishonest activities. But virtually all of the shenanigans and escapades Morty uncovers are ones of his own doing!

programme.title: Black Hawk Down
programme.desc: Based on the true story of a war waged in Mogadishu by the high-tech Black Hawk helicopters and the US Army Rangers and Deltas.

programme.title: Pompeii
programme.desc: Set in 79 A.D., POMPEII tells the epic story of Milo, a slave-turned-invincible gladiator who finds himself in a race against time to save his true love, Cassia, the beautiful daughter of a wealthy merchant.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: A man robbed of his name and his dignity strives to win them back and gain the freedom of his people in this epic historical drama from director Ridley Scott.

programme.title: Wes Craven Presents: They
programme.desc: Lifelong friends begin experiencing the "night terrors" that plagued them as children, convincing them that a supernatural force is pursuing them.

programme.title: Wes Craven Presents: Dracula 2000
programme.desc: Master of horror Wes Craven presents a sexy, modern-day adaptation of the classic Gothic thriller. After Dracula is awakened from his 100-year slumber, he makes America his first destination, specifically the exotic city of New Orleans.

programme.title: Wes Craven Presents Dracula II: Ascension
programme.desc: In this follow up to the hit horror film Wes Craven's Dracula 2000, a group of medical students discover the body of the infamous count.

programme.title: Roman J. Israel, Esq.
programme.desc: A driven, idealistic defense attorney's life is suddenly disrupted when he is recruited to join a firm led by ambitious lawyer George Pierce and begins a friendship with a young champion for equal rights.

programme.title: A Soldier's Story
programme.desc: A fine drama set during World War II, in which a black military attorney investigates the death of a black sergeant. The lawyer eventually discovers that the sergeant was both ashamed of his own culture and virulently hated by his men.

programme.title: The Equalizer 2
programme.desc: Denzel Washington returns to one of his signature roles in the first sequel of his career. Robert McCall serves unflinching justice for the exploited and oppressed – but how far will he go when it is someone he loves?

programme.title: Raging Fire
programme.desc: Shan (Donnie Yen) is a hardline cop with a long history of success, but his past comes back to haunt him when a sting is attacked by a group led by his former protégé (Nicholas Tse), a man set on destroying everyone who ever wronged him.

programme.title: Sakra
programme.desc: Starring & directed by international action star Donnie Yen—When a respected martial artist is accused of murder, he goes on the run in search of answers about his own mysterious origin story and the unknown enemies working to destroy him.

programme.title: Silat Warriors: Deed of Death
programme.desc: When a young gambler runs afoul of the gang rigging a local betting ring, his luck soon runs out. When they show up to collect, he faces dire consequences, and his siblings must fight for their land and their lives—before time runs out.

programme.title: Miss Congeniality
programme.desc: International screen sensation Sandra Bullock stars as an FBI agent who goes undercover as a beauty contestant to capture a terrorist in this hilarious action-comedy.

programme.title: The Bounty Hunter (2010)
programme.desc: Milo is a bounty hunter who gets his dream job when he is assigned to track down his bail-jumping reporter ex-wife. When she gives him the slip so she can chase a lead on a murder cover-up, Milo realizes that nothing ever goes smoothly with her.

programme.title: Code Name: The Cleaner
programme.desc: Cedric the Entertainer brings the funny as Jake Rodgers, a janitor in a dirty world who becomes our only hope! He might have no memory after being assaulted by mysterious villains, but nothing can stop the spirit of this Regular Joe.

programme.title: Watching The Detectives
programme.desc: A film noir buff to the extreme (Cillian Murphy) is given a taste of his own medicine and has his life turned upside down by a kooky femme fatale (Lucy Liu) with a big adventure in mind. Sometimes love is stranger than fiction.

programme.title: The Ex
programme.desc: After getting fired, a man winds up working for his wife's father while she takes care of the baby.

programme.title: I Love You, Man
programme.desc: A friendless groom-to-be meets the ultimate dude and the two begin a "bro-mance" which takes male-bonding to hilarious new heights that will keep you laughing to the end.

programme.title: Patriot Games
programme.desc: Jack Ryan is caught in the middle of a terrorist attack. Ryan helps to thwart Holmes’ assailants and becomes a local hero. But Ryan’s act marks him as a target. Now he must return to action to save his family.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: When his mentor, Admiral James Greer, becomes ill, Ryan is appointed acting CIA Director of Intelligence.

programme.title: The Sum of All Fears
programme.desc: East-West tensions erupt when the CIA suspects that renegade Russian scientists are developing more nuclear weapons.

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: A high-school boy is given the chance to write a story for Rolling Stone Magazine about an up-and-coming rock band as he accompanies it on their concert tour.

programme.title: Catch Me If You Can
programme.desc: From three-time Oscar-winning director Steven Spielberg, Catch Me If You Can follows Frank W. Abagnale, Jr. as he successfully passes himself off as a pilot, a lawyer, and a doctor - all before his 21st birthday!

programme.title: The Virgin Suicides
programme.desc: In the mid-1970s, in a Michigan community, live the Lisbon sisters, five teenagers who have bewitched a group of neighborhood boys.

programme.title: The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance
programme.desc: Jimmy Stewart plays the bungling but charming big-city lawyer determined to rid the fair village of Shinbone of its number one nuisance and bad man: Liberty Valance.

programme.title: Red Headed Stranger
programme.desc: Revisionist western about fallen preacher Shay, who guns down his wife Raysha for running off with another man. Wandering, he meets single mom Laurie. However, helpless sheriff Scoby wants Shay to help him fight the villainous Clavers.

programme.title: Posse
programme.desc: There's action galore in this off-beat western that features a group of mostly black infantrymen who return from the Spanish-American War with a cache of gold. The men travel to the West where their leader searches for the men who lynched his father.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: There's nothing more exciting than trying to keep up with the Joneses in Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade. Indy's Nazi enemies are back and have kidnapped his father in their effort to locate the sacred Holy Grail.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
programme.desc: STEVEN SPIELBERG and GEORGE LUCAS present Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull. Join Indy as he races against a brilliant and beautiful agent for the mystical, all-powerful crystal skull of Akator in this thrilling adventure!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: When New York City is in trouble, it’s up to the four ninja-fighting, pizza-loving brothers to save it. Aided by determined reporter April O’Neil and their wise master Splinter, these unlikely heroes must face their ultimate nemesis - the evil Shredder.

programme.title: Attack the Block
programme.desc: ATTACK THE BLOCK is a fast, funny, frightening action adventure movie that pits a teen street gang against an invasion of savage alien monsters. It turns a crazy mix of tough street kids into a team of kick-ass heroes.

programme.title: Rush Hour
programme.desc: The fastest hands in the East meet the biggest mouth in the West when legendary martial arts daredevil Jackie Chan teams with comedic powerhouse Chris Tucker in Rush Hour.

programme.title: Rush Hour 2
programme.desc: While vacationing together in Hong Kong, fast-talking LAPD Detective Carter and Hong Kong Police Inspector Lee investigate when a bomb explodes in the American embassy.

programme.title: The Craft: Legacy

programme.title: Bad Boys

programme.title: Bad Boys II

programme.title: Jackie Brown
programme.desc: A female flight attendant becomes a key figure in a plot between the police and an arms dealer.

programme.title: The Game Changer

programme.title: The Brink

programme.title: Striking Rescue
programme.desc: Tony Jaa is in top form as Bai An, a muay thai expert seeking revenge against the men who brutally murdered his wife and child. Jaa dominates the screen with powerful flying knees and elbows, proving he’s still one of the best there is.

programme.title: Miss Congeniality
